speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This includes some Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) countries, like Lao PDR and Cambodia.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: IDA was started in 1960 and is replenished every three years or so.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Singapore has been contributing to IDA replenishments since 2002.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: While no country has been spared, the effects have been felt much more greatly by the most vulnerable, especially the 78 IDA-eligible low-income countries.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Many have yet to even recover from the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Apart from domestic development, IDA21 will also enable beneficiaries to address common challenges in areas like health and the environment.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: IDA21 will also support improvements to crisis-readiness for health emergencies as well as pandemic preparedness, prevention and response.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: These have positive spin-offs for the international community as a whole.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Hence, as a responsible member, Singapore should continue to do our part by supporting the IDA21 replenishment.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The World Bank Group has a good track record as an effective development partner.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: And Singapore has benefited from its loans and technical expertise during our early years.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: These had helped us to develop some key infrastructure, including our water supply, sewage, port, power and telecommunication systems.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The Bank also supported the expansion of the then-Development Bank of Singapore and the National University of Singapore.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: As such, it is right that we also support others who are seeking to develop; and pay special attention to the most vulnerable.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: IDA's hybrid financing model also has an in-built multiplier of about four.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This means that for every dollar contributed by Singapore or any other donor, IDA is able to mobilise around $4 in financial support for IDA-eligible countries.
